Every clause of Lemma A.6 is stated in Lean for the general parameter a = 1+h > 1: positivity and closed-half-line smoothness of the gamma integral (A.32), a fixed-order derivative bound that is uniform rather than merely local, the exact formula s^(-A)H(2τ/s), the swirl heat equation in forward time with an arbitrary normalisation constant, strict radial decrease for a positive constant, and joint smoothness of H(2(1-η²)/X) across η = ±1. Axial independence is proved as an identity (heatCoefficient_z_invariant, heatCoefficient_partialZ), though for the swirl coefficient K/r rather than K. No declaration bundles the clauses; both points are packaging. Two clauses are stated more strongly than the paper claims, hence lean_stronger rather than equivalent.

findings.summary: No single declaration states Lemma A.6; its clauses are separate theorems — positivity and smoothness of `profile`, its derivative bounds, the heat equation and K_r<0 for `radialProfile`, and the η-endpoint smoothness of `physicalProfile`.

Clause (iii)'s ∂_z = 0 is proved for the swirl coefficient K/r, not for K itself: `heatCoefficient_partialZ` and `heatCoefficient_z_invariant` are stated for `heatCoefficient = physicalHeat C (1+h) p / √(2·p.2.1)`.
